title: Qualify for the Boston Marathon
claims: The 2027 Boston Marathon is scheduled for 19 April 2027 and the 2028 Boston Marathon for 17 April 2028.
Qualifying standards for 2027 and 2028 include 2:55:00 for men aged 18–34 and 3:25:00 for women and non-binary athletes aged 18–34.
Qualifying standards for 2027 and 2028 include 4:50:00 for men aged 80 and over and 5:20:00 for women and non-binary athletes aged 80 and over.
Standards become more lenient by five-year age group.
Qualifying times are based on official submitted net time (chip time) and must be run on a certified full marathon course.
The qualifier registration cut-off for acceptance into the 2027 Boston Marathon was 5 minutes 17 seconds.
The qualifying window for the 2027 Boston Marathon began on 13 September 2025.
Qualifier registration for the 2027 Boston Marathon ran from 14 September to 18 September 2026 and was not first-come, first-served.
Verified qualifying times from courses with a net downhill of 1,500–2,999 ft receive a 5:00 adjustment, 3,000–5,999 ft a 10:00 adjustment, and 6,000 ft or more is not accepted.
From 2027, about 1,000 qualifiers who are not faster than the cut-off are randomly selected through the Boston Qualifier Selection.
Athletes must be at least 18 years old on race day.
